evidence.title: Eco-warriors want to turn up the heat on your wallet to fund their climate agenda

occurrences.checkable_against: New Jersey legislative records and bill text for the proposed Polluters Pay to Make New Jersey More Affordable Act
occurrences.quote_span: Perhaps to hide this fact, New Jersey legislators renamed their $50-billion assessment to the proposed "Polluters Pay to Make New Jersey More Affordable Act."

occurrences.subject: Climate litigation, superfund laws and federal climate legislation

occurrences.checkable_against: The lawsuits, statutes and federal bill cited in the article, plus an independently reproduced household energy-cost analysis
occurrences.quote_span: If you think your energy bills are high now, just wait until the climate activists get their way. They’ve launched a massive, nationwide campaign of lawfare which, if successful, would raise the average household’s annual energy bill by almost $1,500 per year and nearly $15,000 over a decade.
